name: KAISER 5 TOURING

specs.notes: BMW M's M5 Touring (G99): a 4.4 twin-turbo V8 plug-in hybrid, 727 PS and 1,000 N m combined, M xDrive, an eight-speed automatic, ~2,550 kg (40 kg over the saloon), 0-100 km/h in 3.6 s. Its torque curve, ratios and aero are estimates.

garage.blurb: A family estate with 727 horsepower and a tonne of torque: the heaviest thing on the street and the quickest to the next junction.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/m5_touring.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
